subject: Executive readout: outcomes, procurement path, and escalation checklist
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@novapulse.ai>, Joe Chen <j.chen@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive readout: outcomes, procurement path, and escalation checklist

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our exec-level conversation and the concrete next steps we agreed to so your team has a single reference. Please flag anything I missed.

Key business outcomes you articulated
- Reduce inference cost per API call by ~30% across peak workloads (priority for Q4)
- Achieve sub-150ms 95th percentile latency for chat assistants in EU/US regions
- Maintain full control over data residency and key management for PII-sensitive flows

Primary pain points
- Current vendor has unpredictable tail latency under burst (impacts UX and conversion)
- Contract rigidity: limited routing/fallback options, no private deployment path for regulated pipelines
- Lack of clear cost profiling by route/model; procurement needs unit economics to compare proposals

Success metrics & timelines
- Pilot (light workload) by mid-May — verify latency and cost per token on representative prompt set
- Procurement decision point by end of June (exec sponsor sign-off)
- If pilot meets SLA and economic thresholds, enterprise roll (dedicated capacity) target in Q3

Procurement path we discussed
1) NDA / legal kickoff (you own legal contacts) – target: 1 week
2) Security docs + SOC2 + KMS details from us – target: 3 business days after NDA
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones to owners and procurement checkpoints
4) Commercial terms + SOW + signature (DocuSign) once pilot outcomes validated

Immediate action items (owner)
- Hannah (me): Share security packet, SOW template, and draft MAP by EOD today [attachments].
- Novapulse: Confirm preferred procurement owner and any required contract clauses (data residency, indemnity) by next Wed (4/16).
- Redwood (Sean/Marissa): Stand up SOC2/KMS Q&A with your security/legal — propose a short call next week.

Attachments included
- Security-Packet.pdf (SOC2 excerpt, data residency note, KMS integration overview)
- SOW-template.docx (pilot scope + success criteria)

Proposed next meeting: 30-min MAP review + timeline sync — Tue 4/15 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET (I’ll send a calendar invite once schedule confirmed).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Security-Packet.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)] [Attachment: SOW-template.docx (DOCX, 42KB)]

From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@novapulse.ai>

Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive readout: outcomes, procurement path, and escalation checklist

Thanks Hannah — useful summary. A few clarifications from my side and items I need you to prioritize so I can move this through Procurement and Legal: 

Clarifications / asks
- Procurement lane: We have a preferred vendor engagement flow — two internal reviews (Security + Finance) before Legal takes contract redlines. Procurement rep is Joe Chen (cc).
- Timeline: We can aim for the mid-May pilot but Legal will need SOC2 Type II (most recent) and a KMS integration note explaining if we can bring our own key.
- Data residency: For the pilot we need assurance that tokens/contexts for EU customers remain in EU region (no cross-border staging).

Legal contact for contractual redlines: Priya Singh (priya.singh@novapulse.ai) — please include her on any contract circulation.

I also want a brief summary slide (1 slide) that calls out: pilot success criteria, cost target, and escalation path. That helps secure exec sign-off.

Elena
VP, Product — Novapulse

Subject: Fwd: Executive readout: outcomes, procurement path, and escalation checklist

Forwarding Elena's note — please prioritize the SOC2 doc and KMS clarification. Quick internal plan: 

Internal asks (owners)
- Security (Priya N.): Pull latest SOC2 Type II report, prepare a 1-page KMS/YubiHSM integration note specific to Novapulse ask about BYOK and region restrictions.
- Solutions (Marissa): Draft a 1-slide pilot success criteria + cost comparison mock for the exec one-pager Elena requested. Include 95th pctl latency and per-call cost estimates for the sample prompt set.
- AE (Hannah): Confirm pilot scope in SOW-template, start MAP draft and populate milestone owners (I attached a MAP skeleton).

Attachments
- MAP-draft-8632.xlsx (skeleton with milestones, owners, and dates) — please review and add owners by EOD Mon.

Escalation note: if Legal pushes back on BYOK or data residency we should be ready with a fallback plan (private VPC deployment + dedicated capacity) and a customer-facing risk statement that outlines tradeoffs and time-to-implement. Marissa and Priya, include rough timelines for that fallback.

Sean

Elena / Joe — thanks for the quick turnaround and the legal contact. Short update on what we’ve done and the next tactical steps so you can circulate to execs: 

What we sent / prepared
- Security packet (SOC2 excerpt + KMS overview) shared 4/11; full SOC2 Type II and KMS note (BYOK options) will be uploaded to the drive by Tue 4/15 EOD.
- Draft MAP (skeleton) circulated internally; Sean asked security and solutions to add owners and timelines — we’ll send the populated MAP by 4/16.
- SOW template attached previously — I’ve marked pilot scope with explicit success criteria and will publish a redline for your review by 4/16.

Proposed pilot & decision checkpoints
- Kickoff: Pilot agent validation environment (limited traffic) — target start 5/12
- Checkpoint #1 (2 weeks): Latency and reliability report — pass/fail (95p < 150ms).
- Checkpoint #2 (4 weeks): Cost per call report and ops playbook. If both pass, move to commercial SOW and signature.

Escalation owners (if blockers appear)
- Technical/regulatory: Priya Natarajan (Redwood Security) — will coordinate KMS and region controls.
- Commercial / SLAs: Sean Gallagher — to handle exceptions or special SLA terms.
- Legal negotiation: Hannah (primary AE) will coordinate redlines and circulate DocuSign.

DocuSign & Drive
- I will send the initial DocuSign envelope for NDA/SOW placeholders once we have Legal contact on cc. Preview link: https://www.docusign.com/initiator/abcd-8632-sign
- Shared folder (read-only to Novapulse): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleNovapulse/

Next meeting
- MAP review + security Q&A: Tue 4/15 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send a calendar invite.

If this looks right I’ll loop Priya Singh (Novapulse Legal) on the DocuSign circulation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
